items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: the only one I can remember, the one he had from Julie, because he used to talk about it so much

ctx.x: How big a snare drum, what kind of a snare, was it a deep one made of metal, or wood, or anything? This was a metal drum.

Metal. Beautiful thing, it was all nickel-plated. That's the drum that I remember well, the only one I can remember, the one he had from Julie, because he used to talk about it so much, and just before he died, he left it to me, and I could remember that one. He had the ordinary big bass drum, but that drum was always about this wide. Eight inches or something. About eight inches or so, and it was the regular size of the regular snap drum, but it was about eight inches wide. Yeah. And it was all nickel-plated. It…
You don't remember anything about the type of sticks he used or anything?
